name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: Removes stale, keyless duplicate copies of your OS Client Certs signing certificate that NSS sometimes caches into cert9.db from verified S/MIME signatures, which can silently break outgoing S/MIME signing. Runs at Thunderbird shutdown and, automatically, right after a signing failure -- then retries the send, paired with a CertVerifier rebuild so decryption of other messages doesn't get corrupted along the way. Fix in 0.7.1: that CertVerifier rebuild now always runs after a cleanup pass, not only when the pass found something to delete -- the cert9.db read itself can disturb NSS's cert-resolution state even when nothing was deleted, so 0.7.0 could skip the fix exactly when it was needed. No other change from 0.7.0. See README.md.
